fields.snapshot: JSON of plan at this version

plan_revisions.rule: append-only; version 1 is the original plan; edits retain stable plan ID

fields.title: text
fields.cycle: integer completion cycle; increment only on done to open

fields.minutes: integer minutes rounded from end minus start; >=1

executions.rule: Separate from plans and task estimates. Completion-linked insert only while task is open in the submitted cycle.

completions.rule: Insert event, optional execution and status transition together with atomic D1 batch. Current done count uses task state, never event count.

reviews.rule: Review and next plan are inserted atomically. Next plan carries improvement text.

date_rules.date_fields: YYYY-MM-DD calendar dates, never converted to UTC
date_rules.timestamps: Stored normalized UTC ISO8601; form interprets datetime-local in Asia/Seoul explicitly, display in Asia/Seoul
date_rules.review_period: Inclusive task due_date range within selected plan; all execution records belonging to those tasks are included
date_rules.late: undeleted open tasks with due_date strictly before Seoul today; due today is not late

aggregation.planned: number of undeleted tasks in selected plan and inclusive due-date range
aggregation.late: those tasks not done with deadline earlier than Seoul today
aggregation.blocked: distinct those task IDs having at least one nonempty trimmed blocked reason
aggregation.estimate: sum of those task estimate minutes
aggregation.actual: sum of all execution minutes for those tasks
aggregation.drilldown: count and time metrics open their underlying task and/or execution records

sort.due: due_date ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC
sort.priority: priority ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC
sort.estimate: estimate ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC
sort.location: browser over server-returned records; search and filters operate on same dataset

public_access: No application login. Anyone with the public link can read and edit. Never store sensitive contents.

security.render: React escaped text; no HTML insertion of user data
security.secrets: D1 binding server-only; no API keys required; no .env or local credentials in source export

daily_routine.creation: Explicit user-selected calendar date; no automatic daily creation
daily_routine.ids: daily-routine-YYYY-MM-DD plan and five stable task IDs
daily_routine.repeat: INSERT OR IGNORE keeps existing edits, completion and deleted state; different date has independent tasks
daily_routine.estimates: Suggested minutes, editable; no execution is generated
